items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: He used to call people Jackson.

ctx.x: Yeah, I mean, not even approaching that level. And I think that's true no matter where you go in this country, if you say Jack. I mean whether you're in Jackson, Mississippi, they might think of Jackson when you say Jackson. That was one of his nicknames. Yeah. He used to call people Jackson.
And Gate. He did, personally. Gate. Gate was another one of his slang endearments.
